name: CrowdRelay — VIRYA OS funding submission executor
description: Executes only explicitly human-approved funding submissions with a configured email adapter.

parameters.jsCode:
const e=$json;if(!e||e.type!=='viryaos.funding.submission_requested'||e.version!==1) throw new Error('Unsupported funding submission event');const d=e.data??{};if(d.human_approved!==true) throw new Error('Funding submission without human approval');const m=d.metadata&&typeof d.metadata==='object'?d.metadata:{};if(String(m.submission_method||'').toLowerCase()!=='email') throw new Error('No configured email submission adapter');const to=String(m.submission_email||d.contact_email||'').trim();if(!to.includes('@')) throw new Error('Missing funding submission email');const subject=String(m.submission_subject||`VIRYA — ${d.title} — wniosek`).slice(0,220);const body=String(m.submission_body||`Dzień dobry,

przesyłamy zatwierdzone zgłoszenie VIRYA do programu „${d.title}”.

Dane zespołu i EPK: https://virya.music/pl/epk/

Prosimy o potwierdzenie otrzymania.

Pozdrawiamy,
VIRYA`);return [{json:{event_id:e.id,action_id:d.action_id,opportunity_id:d.opportunity_id,SendTo:to,SendSubject:subject,SendBody:body}}];

const src=$('Validate human-approved email submission').item.json||{};const sent=$json||{};return [{json:{action_id:src.action_id,claim_token:$('Resolve provider execution claim').item.json.claim_token,status:'succeeded',provider_reference:String(sent.id||sent.messageId||sent.threadId||'gmail').slice(0,240),metadata:{event_id:src.event_id,provider:'gmail',domain_transition:'submitted'},occurred_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
const src=$('Resolve provider execution claim').item.json||{}; throw new Error(`Provider outcome ambiguous for action ${src.action_id||'unknown'}; claim retained to prevent automatic duplicate`);
